name: 14886 · Trumansburg, NY
findings: ZIP 14886 (Trumansburg) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14886 (Trumansburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14886 (Trumansburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
